You can react to a message quickly using emojis. Reactions keep your conversations light and expressive.

 The message sender may be notified when you react to their message.

### Important to know

 This feature isn’t available on mobile browser and to mobile app users in China.

 To react to a message:

- Click the  Messaging icon at the top of your LinkedIn homepage.

- You can also click on the messaging conversation window at the lower-right corner of your LinkedIn homepage.

- Open the conversation.

- Move your cursor over the message and click a reaction from the menu that appears.

- To see more emojis, click the  Emoji icon.

 To remove your reaction, click or tap the same emoji again.

 To see who reacted to your message, move your cursor over the emoji or tap and hold on the emoji.
